KCN Tiên Sơn nằm trên địa bàn của hai hu.en: KNNA Shan is located on the territory of the two districts of Elf Du and from Shan, which is also part of the area of the Industry Economic Growth – Sea Hall – Ninzhin. With extremely convenient traffic, the south of KCN bordered the new Highway 1 to the Mountain Road, the North with the Old 1A Highway. Furthermore, East KNN bordering South Canal – The Vadim and the West has the province of 295. Not only that, the distance from KNNA Shan to the Imperial Airport, the sea port, the station is also very close and easy to travel.
KCN Tiên Sơn nằm trên địa bàn của hai hu.zh: 科威特 山地地处榆林都城两县境内并出自山地,山地也属于工业经济增长区-滨海会馆-宁津. 在交通极为便利的情况下,克新铁路以南与新1号高速公路接壤至山地道,以北与老1A高速公路接壤. 此外,与南运河接壤的东克南-瓦迪姆和西部有295个省份。 不仅如此,从克能纳山到帝国机场,海港的距离也非常相近并方便出行.

Khoảng cách từ Sài Gòn đến KCN Tiên Sơn.en: The distance from Saigon to KNNA Shan is remote, but traffic is extremely convenient. Since these are both major economic areas, connection is easy. You can choose to move to KNC Shan by air or road. But with the characteristics of the goods sent out of KCN as Melanthius, the mass of the railway is still the leading option.
Khoảng cách từ Sài Gòn đến KCN Tiên Sơn.zh: 从西贡到克能纳山的距离很遥远,但交通极为便利. 由于这两个领域都是主要的经济领域,所以联系很容易。 你可以选择通过空中或公路迁移到KNC Shan. 但随着被从克CN送出的货物被称作"梅兰修斯"(Melanthius)的特征,铁路质量仍然是首要的选择.

Khu công nghiệp Tiên Sơn có địa chỉ ở Th.en: The Yushan Industrial Zone has an address in the Towns from Shan, North Ning Province, with the area of the KNC being 449ha, the ratio is 100% filled. Along with major investments in and abroad as the Vinamil Milk Company, Canon Vietnam (NDF), AB Company (TR),... Some of the most invested industries at Vinamil Milk Company such as electronic, mechanical, brick, machine maker,...

Khu công nghiệp Tiên Sơn được đầu tư cơ.en: The Yushan Industrial Zone is invested in infrastructure, internal property - synchronization. With internal traffic occupying over 15% of the total KCN area. There are two 37m wide main roads divided into 2 lanes, adding 28 metres wide branches. Electric in the NNC Shan was issued from the National Electric grid via the 110/22kV transformer station. The water system also supplies fully, with a capacity of 30,000 m3. day and night. Besides, in KNNA Shan there are numerous other facilities such as waste processing, banking, telecommunications post office,... All invested in full construction, which enabled businesses in KNNN to operate most productively.
Khu công nghiệp Tiên Sơn được đầu tư cơ.zh: 玉山工业区投资基础设施,内部地产-同步. 国内交通占科索沃国民党总面积的15%以上。 有两条37米宽的主干道被分为2道,增加了28米宽的分道. NNC山地电由国家电网通过110/22kV变压站发售. 供水系统也全面供水,日夜供水能力为30,000立方米. 此外克南山还有许多其他设施,如垃圾处理,银行,电信邮局,...... 全部投资全部建造,使KNN的企业能够最有成效地经营。
